mapper.sql: FROM ledger_entry le LEFT JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.payment_type_id = le.payment_type_id AND pt.camp_id = le.camp_id AND pt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = le.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = le.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = le.order_id AND om.camp_id = le.camp_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = le.camp_id AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id AND r.camp_id = le.camp_id AND r.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS id, p.poi_name AS name FROM pms_poi p WHERE p.camp_id = #{campId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.poi_id ASC

SELECT CAST(pw.payment_way_id AS CHAR) AS value, pw.payment_way_name AS label FROM payment_way pw WHERE pw.camp_id = #{campId} AND pw.status = 1 AND pw.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pw.sort_no ASC, pw.payment_way_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN le.entry_type = 'income' THEN le.amount_cent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncomeCent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN le.entry_type = 'expense' THEN le.amount_cent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpenseCent

SELECT CAST(le.ledger_entry_id AS CHAR) AS ledgerEntryId, CAST(le.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, le.entry_type AS entryType, CAST(le.payment_type_id AS CHAR) AS paymentTypeId, COALESCE(pt.payment_type_name, '-') AS paymentTypeName, CAST(le.payment_way_id AS CHAR) AS paymentWayId, COALESCE(pw.payment_way_name, '-') AS paymentWayName, CAST(le.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, le.source_type AS sourceType, le.amount_cent AS amountCent, le.occurred_at AS occurredAt, le.operator_name AS operatorName, le.remark AS remark, om.order_no AS orderNo, om.out_order_no AS outOrderNo, om.status AS orderStatus, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, r.room_name AS roomName
ORDER BY le.occurred_at DESC, le.ledger_entry_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
